title: Ark moved from Axum to Lake Ziway during the Italian occupation
summary: Graham Hancock tells of Ark moved from Axum to Lake Ziway during the Italian occupation, about 1935-1941 at Axum to an island on Lake Ziway, Ethiopia, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.
place_text: Axum to an island on Lake Ziway, Ethiopia

tellings.quote: um the Ethiopians say that they took the ark out of Axum. Uh and they took it to another place of safekeeping.

plain: A writer on lost ancient civilisations, Graham Hancock, says the Ethiopians tell of the Ark of the Covenant, the sacred chest from the Bible, being moved when Italy occupied Ethiopia between 1935 and 1941. According to them, it was taken out of Axum, a holy city in the north, to an island on Lake Ziway for safekeeping. The story matters because it says where the Ark was kept.
